fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 46% match is a weak fit for this Marketing Operations Associate role, though your email foundation is real.

**Strengths:**
- Mailchimp email campaigns from your Harbor Street Pet Supply internship
- B.A. Communications plus HubSpot Content Marketing course (2024)
- Excel, Google Analytics and Instagram Insights reporting experience

**Gaps:**
- No Marketo, Eloqua, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Salesforce CRM experience
- No B2B technology environment experience
- No lead database segmentation or email compliance knowledge

**Recommendation:** Build Marketo and email compliance basics (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) plus a segmentation project in Mailchimp or HubSpot, then apply to B2B marketing operations roles.

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

A campaign only works if the right message reaches the right people without errors. At Harbor Street Pet Supply I sent one newsletter a week in Mailchimp and grew the list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers by adding a sign-up QR code at the till. That is the kind of operational detail your Campaign Operations team handles at global scale for the APJ Marketing team.

Your ad asks for someone detail-oriented, analytical and able to report on campaign performance. As a Marketing Intern I wrote and scheduled every send and post, then checked results in Google Analytics and Instagram Insights. As Social Media Lead for the Westbrook Film Society, I raised average ticket sales from 35 to 60 per event with a weekly reel, and I trained two new volunteers along the way. I haven't worked in Marketo yet, but I know Mailchimp and Excel, completed the HubSpot Content Marketing course, and I'm keen to learn marketing automation and reporting tools. My B.A. in Communications and my thesis survey of 212 students taught me to turn data into recommendations.

I'm looking to start my first full-time marketing role with a team that values collaboration and growth, and Datadog's product training and mentor program appeal to me. I'm available for an interview at your convenience and would welcome the chance to talk through how I can support your email program.

Best regards,
Maya Linden
